extraction.Name: William A. Pierce
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I owed some debts and my creditors were urging payment
extraction.NOTES: Paid Hancock approximately $520 at time of sale; debt consisted of hay and cottonseed cake; Hancock acted as agent for Peterson who finally got the land; Hancock charged for his trips to Oacoma in connection with his claim; actual money received in hand was $100.00; land sold for approximately $4000.00 less commission; debts were incurred after the patent was given; has three children; affidavit sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on April 29, 1929; document number 2572
